items.headline: UCF fined for fans' chants at BYU; Big 12 sets policy with in-game penalties
items.description: The Big 12 fined UCF $100,000 for fans' derogatory chants aimed at BYU and also set a new policy on "discriminatory conduct" that includes in-game penalties.

items.headline: UCF's Frost: 'Don't think we'll have a letdown' after double-OT win vs. BYU
items.description: Coach Scott Frost is doubling down on intensity after UCF's double-overtime upset of BYU on Saturday, as the Knights prepare for their Friday night game against Baylor.
